description.value: Khaghan is a modern Persian restaurant specialising in fire-grilled meats, fragrant saffron stews, and traditional dishes made with halal-certified meats and imported Iranian rice. The multi-level venue includes a street-level dining room, a second-floor event space with 40-foot ceilings and floor-to-ceiling glass, and a patio. Weekend evenings feature live music and dance, making it a lively destination for groups as well as solo diners.
